name: codex-bridge-chatgpt
description: Bridge complex repository reasoning from Codex to ChatGPT while keeping execution and verification local.

interface.shortDescription: Use ChatGPT for hard reasoning while Codex verifies locally.
interface.longDescription: A verified reasoning handoff for Mac and Windows ChatGPT desktop users. Codex minimizes repository evidence, sends a bounded packet to ChatGPT in the built-in browser, validates the result, and keeps all edits and tests local.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to diagnose and fix this complex repository problem.
Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to review this architecture decision.
Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to find the root cause and verify the fix.
